# Fixed hb-gpu renderer corpus

Development/test fixtures only. Generated by
`scripts/generate-hb-gpu-corpus.mjs` and
`scripts/reference/hb-gpu-fixture-encoder.cc` from HarfBuzz commit
`c31bd6797a0e55c2b176a7be3a181f36814ec6aa` using Microsoft C/C++ compiler
19.44.35219 for x64. `manifest.json` records each bundle's glyph IDs, byte
length and SHA-256 digest.

The source fonts retain their provenance and license references in
`test/fixtures/fonts/README.md`.
HarfBuzz is distributed under its upstream old-MIT style license; the vendored
WGSL retains the complete upstream notices. These binary bundles must never be
included in web or Electron production artifacts.
